title: Standalone BCa bootstrap Sharpe-ratio CI tool (backtesting/tools/bootstrap_sharpe_ci.py)
rationale: Self-generated from tonight's Phase 1 wiki finding (wiki/trading/tools/pybroker.md, PyBroker's BCa bootstrap confidence intervals on Sharpe/Profit Factor). Every run_hNNN.py in backtesting/daily/ reports a single point-estimate OOS Sharpe against a fixed numeric gate (e.g. 1.174) with no sense of margin of error -- a hypothesis clearing the gate by 0.01 and one clearing it by 1.0 are both logged 'CONFIRMED' identically. Rather than pulling in the full PyBroker package (which would mean adopting its Strategy/StrategyConfig execution model just to get one statistic, a larger migration than the wiki page itself recommends -- see pybroker.md's own 'Relevance to pipeline' section: 'retrofit... without migrating the whole pipeline off pandas'), this reimplements PyBroker's specific methodology (BCa bootstrap, resampled per-bar not per-trade) directly with numpy/scipy, both already present in venv/ (scipy 1.17.1 confirmed installed, no new dependency, no pip install needed -- checked per the persona.md package-installation security rule before deciding not to add PyBroker itself as a dependency). Duplicate-check: confirmed via grep -rl across backtesting/ and wiki/ -- no existing bootstrap/BCa/confidence-interval implementation anywhere in the codebase; genuinely new capability, not a duplicate. Written and functionally tested this session (synthetic 96-month return series, seed=1, produced point=1.398 CI=[0.631, 2.116] -- CI width and shape are sane for n=96 monthly periods). This is a new, standalone file (backtesting/tools/bootstrap_sharpe_ci.py) that does not modify or wrap any existing run_hNNN.py script, so it carries no risk to the existing hypothesis-testing pipeline; it is opt-in, to be imported into a run_hNNN.py file only when a researcher chooses to add a CI sanity-check to a specific hypothesis re-run. Does not address the as_of-date look-ahead bug family (H510-H514 etc.) -- purely a statistical-power addition, scoped identically to the caveat already written into pybroker.md.
content: See /workspace/agent/backtesting/tools/bootstrap_sharpe_ci.py -- file already written and functionally tested this session (no existing target to back up, per task-registry build-phase convention: 'For NEW files (no existing target), skip the backup'). Library usage: `from backtesting.tools.bootstrap_sharpe_ci import bootstrap_sharpe_ci; ci = bootstrap_sharpe_ci(returns, periods_per_year=12)` returns `{point, lo, hi, n_boot, n_periods}`. CLI usage: `python3 backtesting/tools/bootstrap_sharpe_ci.py returns.csv --periods-per-year 12`.
